Machine God Soldiers were stationed at Storage Depot![XENO:n ]
Defeat their leader to weaken the enemy forces.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Plum-Blossom Vagul[/System:Color ] in the Storage Depot.

You defeated the leader of the stationed[XENO:n ]
enemy unit, weakening their forces.

Machine God Soldiers were waiting inside the factory![XENO:n ]
Defeat the enemies blocking your way and break through.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]M96 Crisis Unit[/System:Color ] at the Machine Soldier Factory.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Crisis Response Units[/System:Color ] in Machine Soldier Factory.
You defeated the waiting enemies and broke through.

Machine God Soldiers lay in wait on the rooftop![XENO:n ]
Defeat the enemy unit's leader.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Venerable Focalor[/System:Color ] on the Training Ground Roof.
You defeated the enemy leader, weakening their forces.

The Weapon Creation Machine in Central Factory[XENO:n ]
can apparently make a new weapon for Fiorung.[XENO:n ]
Take the materials there and make her a weapon.

Use the Weapon Creation Machine at Central Factory's[XENO:n ]
Control Tower to make a weapon.
You made a weapon for Fiorung.

The lift to Central Factory's Central Tower has stopped.[XENO:n ]
Find another route.
Go to Maintenance Entrance 1.
The lift beside the Maintenance Wing may take you up.

An electrical barrier blocks the Maintenance Wing's path[XENO:n ]
to the lift. Disable it to reach the lift.

Use the Barrier Control Panel to release the[XENO:n ]
electrical barrier.
You disabled the barrier at the Maintenance Wing.

The vertical lift to the next level has stopped.[XENO:n ]
The Machine Soldier Factory may provide a way up.[XENO:n ]
Find somewhere to enter the factory.
Find a way into the Machine Soldier Factory.
Collect materials for the bomb.
Make a bomb at Maintenance Wing's Weapon Creation Panel.
Use the bomb to blast open the vent.
You destroyed the vent, allowing entry to the factory.

A bomb could blow open the vent and let you[XENO:n ]
into the factory. Obtain the bomb materials from[XENO:n ]
Machine God Soldiers on 3F of Central Factory.

Obtain an [System:Color name=item ]Electrical Fuse[/System:Color ][XENO:n ]
from M88 Watchtower guarding the Main Factory Gate.

Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Black Ether Explosive[/System:Color ][XENO:n ]
from M97 Commander in the Large Machine Depot.

Obtain a [System:Color name=item ]Timer[/System:Color ] from Offensive Scout, a flying[XENO:n ]
Machine God Soldier at the central container depot.

You have the materials to make a bomb[XENO:n ]
at the Maintenance Wing's Weapon Creation Panel.

An electrical barrier blocks the way to Central Tower.[XENO:n ]
Disable it and head to the upper part of the tower.
Turn off the electrical barrier.
Head to Central Tower.
You have arrived at the transporter to the capital.
